description: This source file provides a simple implementation of dynamic scoping for certain parameters using thread-local storage and context managers. It defines classes, functions, and context management utilities to temporarily override and access configuration parameters related to tensor handling in a code generation context.

classes.name: Locals
classes.description: A thread-local class holding configuration flags for tensor mutability and list referencing.

methods.name: bool use_const_ref_for_mutable_tensors()
methods.description: Returns the current setting for using const references for mutable tensors, asserting that it has been initialized.

methods.name: bool use_ilistref_for_tensor_lists()
methods.description: Returns the current setting for using i-list references for tensor lists, asserting that it has been initialized.

methods.name: Iterator[None] parametrize( *, use_const_ref_for_mutable_tensors: bool, use_ilistref_for_tensor_lists: bool )
methods.description: A context manager that temporarily overrides the local parameters for tensor handling, restoring previous values upon exit.
